item.title: Rallying Cry – September 10, 2026
item.description: Coco Gauff makes a thrilling comeback to reach the US Open semifinals, while Ecuador gets a boost with new US security funding and naval support, and Mexico’s Supreme Court marks a year of progress with a focus on austerity and public service.
